# railway_bucket (Resource)

A Railway object storage bucket, as `railway.Bucket`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "environment_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "railway_bucket" "backups" {
  environment_id = var.environment_id
  name           = "backups"
  region         = "sjc"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) ID of the Railway environment that holds this bucket. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `name` (String) Name of the bucket. Railway IaC addresses resources by name, so renaming replaces it.

### Optional

- `group` (String) Name of the canvas group the bucket belongs to.
- `region` (String) `sjc`, `iad`, `ams` or `sin`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<environment_id>/<address>`, for example `c2b9…/bucket.web`.
- `live_changes` (List of String) Changes Railway needs to match this configuration, as `railway config plan` lists them. Empty after an apply; a refresh fills it when the live environment drifts, and the next plan applies them.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the Railway project the environment belongs to.
- `railway_id` (String) Railway's ID for this bucket.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <environment_id>/bucket.<name>
terraform import railway_bucket.backups 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/bucket.backups
```
